aviation_incidents.headline: 印度航空波音787因安全疑慮轉降齋浦爾
aviation_incidents.summary: 印度航空AI2030班機於10月14日執行法蘭克福至德里航班，途中發出可能遭劫持警示後轉降齋浦爾。報導指出，該班機由波音787-9執飛，並於齋浦爾安全降落。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air India Boeing 787 diverts to Jaipur after perceived security concern
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Air India flight AI2030 was operating from Frankfurt to Delhi on 14 October aboard a Boeing 787-9. The aircraft diverted to Jaipur after sending an alert for a possible hijacking and landed safely at about 09:35 local time (04:05 UTC), according to the report.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國議員要求暫停SMART空管系統，質疑上線前測試
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國議員要求聯邦航空總署（FAA）暫停人工智慧空中交通管理系統SMART，並質疑係統在投入服務前是否經過充分測試。報導指出，SMART於9月21日在Ronald Reagan Washington National、Washington Dulles International及Baltimore/Washington International機場開始運作。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: US lawmakers seek pause to SMART air traffic system over safety testing
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Twenty-five US lawmakers are calling on the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to suspend SMART, an AI-powered air traffic management system, while questioning whether it was adequately tested before entering service. SMART began operating on 21 September at Ronald Reagan Washington National, Washington Dulles International and Baltimore/Washington International airports.

aviation_incidents.headline: 英國航空A321客艙窗戶裂痕後折返蓋特威克並安全降落
aviation_incidents.summary: 英國航空一架空中巴士A321於飛往葡萄牙途中，因機組回報客艙窗戶裂痕而預防性折返倫敦蓋特威克。報導指出，BA2660航班原定飛往Faro，從蓋特威克起飛約一小時後折返；機組曾發出表示一般緊急狀況的7700應答機代碼。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: British Airways Airbus A321 returns to Gatwick after cracked window report
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A British Airways Airbus A321 made a precautionary return to London Gatwick after crew reported a cracked passenger window during a flight to Portugal. Flight BA2660 was en route to Faro and turned back roughly an hour into the flight after departing Gatwick. The crew transmitted squawk 7700, a standard transponder code used to indicate a general emergency.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 史瓦帝尼政府A340專機由桃園轉場高雄　轉場目的尚待官方說明
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開航跡顯示，史瓦帝尼王國政府一架Airbus A340-313X專機於今（14）日中午自桃園國際機場（TPE）起飛，轉場前往高雄國際機場（KHH）。航班追蹤資料列出該機於臺北時間下午12時05分起飛，原預計下午1時24分抵達高雄。目前尚未取得官方對此次轉場目的的說明，無法僅憑航跡確認是否涉及航機保養或其他安排。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Eswatini Government A340 Repositions From Taoyuan to Kaohsiung; Purpose Awaiting Official Confirmation
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public flight tracking shows an Eswatini government Airbus A340-313X departing Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) around midday today, October 14, to reposition to Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH). Tracking data recorded departure at 12:05 Taipei time and initially estimated arrival in Kaohsiung at 13:24. No official explanation of the purpose of this repositioning has been obtained, and the flight path alone cannot establish whether it involves aircraft maintenance or other arrangements.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部稱偵獲中共軍機13架次出海 其中11架次逾越中線
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部表示，自上午9時30分起，陸續偵獲中共各型軍機13架次出海，其中11架次逾越中線，進入臺灣北部、中部及西南空域。國防部稱，相關軍機配合共艦活動，並以「聯合戰備警巡」之名在臺灣周邊空、海域活動。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan defence ministry reports 13 Chinese military aircraft sorties, 11 crossing median line
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 13 sorties by Chinese military aircraft departing over the sea from 9:30 a.m. It said 11 sorties crossed the median line and entered airspace north, central and southwest of Taiwan.

international_aviation.summary: 波音（Boeing）公佈第三季商用飛機交付數據。根據Aerospace Global News報導，波音確認第三季交付161架商用飛機，今年前九個月累計交付475架。

international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing has reported its third-quarter commercial aircraft delivery figures. According to Aerospace Global News, the manufacturer confirmed it delivered 161 commercial aircraft in the third quarter and 475 commercial deliveries in the first nine months of the year.

international_aviation.headline: SpaceX限制Starshield移動終端速度 烏克蘭部隊稱部分無人機任務取消
international_aviation.summary: 烏克蘭官員表示，SpaceX在夜間對使用Starshield軍用通訊服務、且處於移動中的終端實施速度限制，事前未作通知。烏克蘭總統Volodymyr Zelenskyy的顧問Serhiy Beskrestnov稱，移動中的Starshield終端限速為每小時100英里（160公里）。官員表示，飛行途中通訊中斷，導致部分無人機任務取消。
international_aviation.headline_en: SpaceX Speed Limits on Starshield Terminals Disrupt Ukrainian Drone Missions
international_aviation.summary_en: SpaceX introduced speed restrictions overnight on terminals operating on its Starshield military service, without advance warning, according to Serhiy Beskrestnov, an adviser to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Beskrestnov said the limit for terminals in motion was 100 mph (160 km/h). Ukrainian officials said communications were interrupted in flight, forcing troops to cancel some drone missions.

international_aviation.headline: CMAC Group調查：57%需後續交通旅客自行安排地面接駁
international_aviation.summary: CMAC Group的調查指出，在需要後續地面交通的航班中斷旅客中，57%自行安排交通。調查也發現，曾需要地面交通的受訪者中，96%至少遇到一項問題。
international_aviation.headline_en: CMAC Group survey finds 57% arranged their own onward ground transport
international_aviation.summary_en: Research by CMAC Group found that 57% of passengers who needed onward ground transport after flight disruption arranged it themselves. The study covered 1,250 disrupted passengers across Europe. Among passengers who needed ground transport, 96% encountered at least one problem.

international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣佈恢復「Flight Deck Training」計畫，讓空中交通管制員可申請搭乘符合資格航班，親身瞭解飛行甲板作業。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA Reinstates Flight Deck Training Program for Air Traffic Controllers
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has announced the reinstatement of its Flight Deck Training program for air traffic controllers. The program lets controllers apply for jumpseat access on eligible flights to gain firsthand experience with flight deck operations.

international_aviation.headline: Shield AI與Honeywell完成兩項自主無人機協同飛行示範
international_aviation.summary: Shield AI與Honeywell Aerospace宣佈，雙方已完成兩項使用Shield AI Hivemind的自主飛行示範，並以兩架無人機執行協同情報、監視與偵察（ISR）任務。首場正式示範飛行於7月8日在明尼蘇達州Plymouth舉行；當次飛行中，無人機自行起飛、沿預定航線飛行，並繞過禁飛區後返回基地。
international_aviation.headline_en: Shield AI and Honeywell complete two autonomous drone demonstrations
international_aviation.summary_en: Shield AI and Honeywell Aerospace announced they had completed two autonomous flight demonstrations using Shield AI’s Hivemind, culminating in a coordinated intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) mission involving two aircraft. The first official demonstration flight took place on July 8 in Plymouth, Minnesota. The drone took off on its own, flew a planned route, rerouted around a no-fly zone and returned to base.

international_aviation.summary: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）與World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance（WSHA）已同意加強航空與旅宿業的永續合作。雙方在World Sustainability Symposium簽署協議，初期聚焦航空公司採購飯店住宿服務。
international_aviation.headline_en: IATA and World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance to Develop Hotel Procurement Guidance
international_aviation.summary_en: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance (WSHA) have agreed to strengthen sustainability alignment between the airline and hospitality sectors. The agreement was signed at the World Sustainability Symposium, with airline procurement of hotel services as its initial focus.
